name: libxsmm-n512-ta-with-timed-sme-b-transpose
hypothesis: Implement only the swarm-selected TA full-call wrapper. The supplied sme_transpose writes bt[k*512+j]=B[j*512+k] into a fresh 1 MiB FP32 buffer inside gemm. Parameter slots are [4]=bt, [10]=original A and [16]=original C; all other slots remain zero. TA retains generated B-stack packing and adds generated A-stack packing. Its different packing and memory access pattern may improve total time, but allocation, conversion and cleanup can outweigh that effect. Performance is unknown. This wrapper is absent from the supplied measured history; the measured TB wrappers do not measure TA. Allocation failure calls unchanged NN with original inputs; n!=512 retains the existing fallback. All assembly, complete BSD notices, ABI, FP32 arithmetic, thread count, compiler flags and tolerance remain unchanged. No tools or tests were run. Require compilation and correctness checks for fresh inputs, full overwrite, input preservation, general sizes, tails, n<=0 and allocation failure at tolerance 0.002. Then collect ten validation reports and ten fresh alternating paired controls with power source and settings unchanged, preserving best-of-three timing. Report spread and comparisons against fresh same-mode peaks and historical AC Automatic peak 1685.6230608449698; keep historical Battery Automatic peak 1668.5964359101147 separate. Comparator policy remains pending. Adoption requires min(candidate)>1.05*max(paired controls) and the unchanged held-out check. No speedup, causal effect or goal completion is established.
